name: Lazarus
background: Raised from the dead by Jesus after four days in the tomb. A living testimony to Jesus's power over death.

genericReactions.physical: What I experienced in the tomb was beyond description. Physical evidence seems almost... incidental compared to what I saw.
genericReactions.testimonial: I was dead. Four days dead. And then His voice called me out. I have no greater testimony than this.
genericReactions.digital: I left behind the records of my household when they thought me lost. Now those records tell the story of something impossible.
genericReactions.environmental: Bethany was crowded with mourners when He arrived. The house was filled with weeping and lamentation — until it was filled with wonder.
genericReactions.analytical: The sequence is clear: death's arrival, the closing of the tomb, the stone rolled away, and then — calling. No natural explanation suffices.
genericReactions.prophecy: What was foretold about death being swallowed up — I lived it. The prophets spoke of resurrection, and here I stand, proof.
